entities.summary: James Ross was a Canadian professional ice hockey player who played 62 games in the National Hockey League with the New York Rangers during the 1951–52 and 1952–53 seasons. He was born in Edinburgh, Scotland, and raised in Toronto, Ontario. He died in 2016.
